notes.content:
[b]Greetings, fellow Warriors![/b]

After a day of fixing issues, we have released a little update for our demo.
The following stuff is out now: 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Trinket slots where not properly displayed in 4-player multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue when a player disconnects during a level up screen
[*] Fixed disconnect icons being displayed on all player portraits in the multiplayer lobby
[*] Fixed a sound issue with an enemy in Red Canyon
[*] Fixed an issue in multiplayer where progress was not properly tracked for the quests that unlock Secret Tincture, Prism & Persistence Rune for clients
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the battle!

Your Warriors Team

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
🚀 [b]Royal Revolt Warriors - Major Demo Update: Online Multiplayer & 4-Player Co-op![/b] 🎉  

Warriors, the time has come! The latest update for the [b]Royal Revolt Warriors[/b] demo is here, and it’s our biggest one yet! ⚔️🔥 

🏆 [b]Main Patch Notes:[/b]

🔹 [u][b]Multiplayer Madness![/b][/u]
- We’ve enabled [i]experimental 2-4 player [b]online multiplayer[/b][/i] via [i]Steam Netplay[/i]!  
- Play with friends [b]locally, online, or even mix[/b] and match both!  

🔹 [u][b]Brand New Warrior![/b][/u]
- Added [b][i]"Moe the Monk"[/i][/b] incl. his ability and weapon enchantment.

🔹 [u][b]New Warrior Abilities![/b][/u]
- [b]Christa:[/b] [i]"Berserk"[/i] – Unleash a furious attack speed boost!  
- [b]Umberto:[/b] [i]"Decoy" [/i]– Lure enemies in with a deadly trap that explodes based on their max HP.  
- [b]Moe:[/b] [i]"Cheers!"[/i] – Sacrifice HP to buff your and your allies’ damage!  
- [b]Sam:[/b] [i]"Satyrical Symphony"[/i] – A soothing melody that heals all nearby allies.  

🔹 [u][b]New Weapons & Enchantments![/b][/u]
- [i]"Tempest Rod"[/i] plus its [i]"Storm Bringer"[/i] enchantment. 🌩️  
- [i]"Valkyrie Spear"[/i] (Enchantment coming soon!).  
- [i]"Gobbotech Mines"[/i] (Explosions incoming!).  
- [b]Gaia Harp Enchantment:[/b] [i]"Autumn Storm"[/i] – Nature’s fury unleashed.   
- [b]Royal Brew Enchantment:[/b] [i]"Volatile Brew"[/i] – Who knew a drink could be this explosive? 💥  

🔹 [u][b]New Trinkets & Improvements![/b][/u]
- [b]Gilded Purse:[/b] – More gold = more upgrades! 💰  
- All Warriors now have[b] unique names[/b] (except the King… he’s still just "The King" 👑).  
- [b]Reworked quests[/b] for better game flow.  
- Rebalanced Blacksmith upgrades & added [b]new[/b] ones.  
- [b]Kunais deal extra damage[/b] on impact before applying poison. 🗡️☠️  
- Monk’s Brew now has a hit sound (because audio cues matter!).  
- Tweaked VFX and [b]fixed tons of bugs[/b]. 🛠️

⚡ [u][b]Some known issues...[/b][/u]
- When playing with 4 players, the UI displays 4 trinket slots for each player, even though only 3 can be filled.
- When playing online, the quests to unlock Secret Tincture, Prism & Persistence Rune only track progress for the host.

As we're adding so much content, features and the new mutliplayer functionality, unfortunatwely we have to wipe all existing savegames of the demo.

🎮 Please help us out and and [b]test our new online co-op now![/b] Your feedback will help us bugfix and fine-tune multiplayer for the full release. Join the Royal Revolt Warriors community, team up with friends, and conquer the madness together! 💪⚔️  

Thank you for your patience while we are working hard to get the release version of the game done as soon as possible!

👉 [url=https://discord.gg/cxnRmzE4]Join our Discord[/url] to share feedback and find teammates!

notes.title: Unmatched Powers: Meet the Blacksmith and their wonders
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/d5961e093f0e65a48a6e8251362fdef64b118197.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/7998e8e5b5bfc1d027ba56f99b4d1252e44fae6a.jpg[/img]

In a familiar land in dire danger, your allies aren't many, [b]but they are crucial[/b].

Among them stands the Mysterious Blacksmith, a shadowy figure cloaked in secrecy, their face forever hidden behind a haunting donkey mask. Whispers speak of their origins in the far reaches of[i] A Trader's Tale[/i], where deals were struck in shadows and fortunes forged in fire. Now, they emerge from obscurity, not as a hero, but [b]as an essential ally in the battle to save the Realms[/b].

For those bold enough to seek their aid—and pay the right price—they offer more than mere tools of war. They forge game-changing upgrades, weapons imbued with strength, and armor that turns the tide of fate itself. With their craft, the once impossible becomes achievable, allowing you to stand where others have fallen, to triumph where even you tasted defeat before.

If the future seems dark to day, one thing is certain: in this war, the right blade or unbreakable shield could mean the difference between victory and ruin. Seek them out, and [b]let the fire of their forge light the path to your destiny.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e8bc5403b2589a1292adf2f6b55cd7e19790aa95.png[/img]

In the heat of battle, [b]every decision shapes your journey, Warrior[/b].

Early on, when resources are limited and challenges are mounting, [b]it’s smart to focus on essential upgrades like Health, Damage, and Attack Speed[/b]. These will give you the tools you need to survive the initial stages. As your wealth increases, [b]it’s time to think strategically[/b]. If you prefer a specific weapon style—whether ranged or melee—consider enhancing the number of attacks it can deliver. Alternatively, [b]investing in Critical Hit Chance and Damage[/b] can help you land harder-hitting strikes right from the start.

As you progress, the Blacksmith becomes even more valuable.[b] They offer powerful tools to refine your loadout[/b], including Rerolls to customize your upgrades, Additional Weapon Slots to diversify your arsenal, and Tomes for early, game-changing enchantments. These features let you adapt and strengthen your strategy, ensuring you’re always ready to face what lies ahead.

Every Warrior has their own path to victory, and with the Blacksmith’s expertise, you’ll have the upgrades you need to turn the tide in your favor. Use their skills wisely, and no challenge will be insurmountable!

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdTdpcnh0Nnh6aWVnMGM5cTFlOXlxbGJlbm9oanVnaWF6cTkzeTZiYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JZcUkAAXcUQBVN5ZKR/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/68c0b883bdde9649d07b281d6c97f6a7c73c2b4b.png[/img]

Several Key Features of the game can only be unlocked at the Blacksmith as the game progresses, such as:

[list]
[*] Rerolls
[*] More Weapon Slots
[*] Additional Tomes used for Weapon Enchantments
[/list]

Every [b]upgrade increases the cost of all others[/b]

[b]All upgrades have a cap[/b]

Upgrades can be refunded free of charge either one by one or all together
[list]
[*] It is advisable to make full use of the Refund depending on your current needs
[/list]

Not every Upgrade is available from the beginning[b], some take certain conditions to unlock[/b]
[list]
[*] Check the Quests Menu for unlock conditions
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e4c21f232e902a5e13d55fb9b3d86a1ad9e2dbc1.png[/img]

When designing the Blacksmith feature for [i]Royal Revolt Warriors [/i]it was important to us to provide players with a slow and steady progression of strength. No one single run, no matter if a map would be completed or not, should feel redundant to our players, since the Gold they earn can always be spent on something useful, that at the same time makes future runs less difficult. This is intended to create a sense of increasing power and battle versatility. So even if a Map proves to be too difficult at first, it can be overcome by tenacity and the help of the Blacksmith.

One challenging aspect of the feature for us as developers, is making sure there is also a steady progression of Gold costs in relation to power level, and at the same time making sure the upgrades are balanced with each other. This requires constant attention since the values need to be revised whenever a new upgrade is implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6aefde975c358e792c556a494edc9c2616a8a553.png[/img]

Creating the character of the mysterious Blacksmith was a very interesting endeavor. 
The design was first introduced in [i]Royal Revolt: A Trader’s Tale[/i], when the King himself initiated a cooperation between the protagonists and the smith, and has been undergoing several striking changes in its early development.

In the end, we settled for the current look, sporting a Donkey mask. This not only serves as a reference to a popular character from Royal Revolt 2 but is also a nod to the god of craftsmen, metalworking and blacksmiths Hephaestus from Greek mythology, whose sacred animal was a Donkey.

The design itself is shrouded in mystery, never speaking a single word, the face hidden behind a strange mask. The Blacksmith’s true identity has yet to be revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6b625704eb2b49114659c05333b140421ad9c296.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/22e9abc9d9ff580d1f5a17b9127a908861e7d2ea.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/4ca2494ee0a5429040ef37ee681bd90e083cc024.jpg[/img]

Wishlist [i]Royal Revolt Warriors[/i] now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960490/Royal_Revolt_Warriors/

notes.title: The Finest of the Realms - Meet Mina, the Royal Advisor
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9420ef7e597d7772a49c0fef476e8af767f00578.png[/img]

[h1]- Always loyal Know-it-All -[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5f0b7edcbe0caa742ed53bb232b41401b420c1b0.jpg[/img]

When the King needs a brain as sharp as a blade, Mina steps up—Advisor, battle strategist, and ultimate problem-solver. Known for her razor-sharp wit and unbreakable loyalty, Mina is the Queen of Comebacks both on and off the battlefield. Now, with her trusty Boomerang, she’s more than just a voice of wisdom—she’s a whirlwind of precision, bringing both brilliance and bruises to every fight. She jokes that her backpack’s like a black hole for everyone’s gear, and her two older brothers, Arthur and Jonathan, would agree—she’s always had the brains of the family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/bb7f8ca9bcd50ed89911c62dfaf8b2be1918257d.png[/img]

[h1]Backpack[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/d4182caddc1bec4bc4efecdd401b2c97cffe078d.png[/img]

Years of joining the King on the battlefield have made Mina a powerful, resourceful and clever companion. What she lacks in physical strength she more than makes up for with her ability to carry Items around in her beloved Backpack:

[list]
[*] The Backpack automatically stores Pickups, allowing Mina to use them at any time or drop them for allies.
[*] Tapping the button uses the item in the backpack, holding down the button throws it forward so your friends can pick it up
[*] As the ability levels up, it can store more types of pickups, beyond just health regeneration items.
[*] At Level 2, Powerups can be added to the Backpack as well.
[/list]

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeWl3MjN1Y3pudjgxdG5kZ3gwY3JlbGR2ZTR3dG9zdDRpaG4wOWlnNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RDDbqQRe9tfeUnE0s1/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/10b26cd6038f3b4eb038209a917f03e7cb2ea8fb.png[/img]

[h1]Boomerang[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/a2a77f9a1dddc0491723cdb229093ef3ab8f2e81.png[/img]

Carrying around a regular Sword in her younger years, Mina has since found the true benefits of wielding a ranged Weapon.

[list]
[*] The Boomerang targets the nearest enemy in a straight line, dealing damage on its way out and back.
[*] Each additional projectile targets random enemies within range.
[*] Leveling up increases projectile count, attack speed, duration, and damage. At max level, the Boomerang will fly past the Advisor on its return, allowing it to hit enemies behind her as well.
[/list]

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYW5tdnd2MHdoZGtmeXlzMXdyd3c5MnhpM2htMnprdmVza2I3eHNwNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/DziBCqgTi6jtCHvxUI/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5b41f221e3edadbdf8843ccf6c288ab99d7b8d57.png[/img]

Weapon Enchantments aimed at the Boomerang, naturally make Mina’s weapon of choice even more powerful, making it a goal worth working towards.

[b]Spiral Boomerang: [/b]Changes the attack pattern to spiral around the Advisor, covering a full 360° radius.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZm9vbGo1dXRtdDY4MThoN3hnd2g4ODNsdGRicWRpNGJwY283OHR6ZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/H0gOaAmmvcL7sihV0r/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/41e8532307dd1ed76639832468771d40e4cb88e9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/54cd77f1cce1177b3bf234ec2db26674a30bb1d1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e8bc5403b2589a1292adf2f6b55cd7e19790aa95.png[/img]

Mina has relatively low health, but her powerful Boomerang weapon more than compensates for it. Like the King, it’s crucial to prioritize upgrading the main Weapon early to unlock its level 8 ability. This removes downtime between attacks, allowing the Advisor to dominate the battlefield from the center while maintaining an upper hand.

Incorporating [b]Gaia Harp[/b] or [b]Monk’s Brew [/b]early on, if available, helps smooth out the randomness of the Boomerang’s attack pattern, giving you more control over the fight. The Boomerang even collects E[b]XP Crystals[/b] automatically, reducing the need for constant movement. However, hunting down barrels, vases or crates for valuable pickups to store in the Backpack is vital. Keeping [b]Ham[/b] handy to heal or a [b]Bomb[/b] to clear enemy waves can be game-changers in tight situations.

As enemies grow tougher, essential trinkets like [b]Prism, Royal Amulet, and Pocket Watc[/b]h will bolster your offensive capabilities. [b]Prism[/b] increases projectile count, benefiting both the Boomerang and [b]Gaia Harp[/b], while [b]Royal Amulet[/b] enhances weapon damage. [b]Pocket Watch[/b] extends the Boomerang's flight and Gaia Harp’s active time, helping you sustain damage output. If you find [b]O.L.U.M.[/b], the increased projectile size will let you hit even more enemies with each attack, boosting your endgame effectiveness.

[h1]Endgame Build[/h1]

Don’t forget to pick up the [b]Golden Compass[/b], which enables the Boomerang’s Enchantment. With the [b]Spiral Boomerang[/b], you’ll shred through enemies in every direction, even overwhelming bosses with ease. Once fully equipped, the Advisor will turn the battlefield into a breeze.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb3o2MGIzYTgyenlkNTB2bG42dTBuNWpibHQ3emltamNwdW4zYnJrMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/aqhwIN4noukwoECvOW/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9cc98d3f32749845fa519038fedfbff10a97d602.png[/img]

In co-op, the Advisor pairs well with a tanky ally like [b]Christa[/b]. Christa can take hits and slow down enemies, giving the Advisor the time needed to clear out threats with her Boomerang and abilities. Together, they create a balanced team where Christa holds the line and the Advisor dishes out relentless damage from a safe distance.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdHVlaGIwb3FjYjZtMzlldXBvYWJudzJvbDQycDA5eWRjdjFzZ2ptNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4RitGpEcYFsMK5W66Y/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6aefde975c358e792c556a494edc9c2616a8a553.png[/img]

While not quite as old as the King’s, Mina’s original design is still up there amongst the historic legacy characters that helped shape[i] Royal Revolt [/i]since its early beginnings. Although she didn’t show up until the sequel in 2013, she has since undoubtedly become the most recognizable face of the franchise, next to the King. She underwent many different outfit and hairdo iterations, before we settled for the now iconic look. Because of the importance of this design, we absolutely wanted to nail her transition from the girl of the past to the young woman she became in [i]Royal Revolt Warriors[/i]. A challenge was to maintain her recognizability, while also showing a more mature personality, as she shed her more bratty spitfire-traits of previous installments to become a more focussed and keen character. Furthermore, since Mina was noticeably absent from [i]Royal Revolt: A Trader's Tale[/i], her new grown up version not only had to stay true to her legacy design, but also fit in seamlessly with the cast members that already received the "aging" treatment.

When thinking about her new Weapon (to avoid the repetition of the Sword she used to wield), the Boomerang occurred to us a natural fit, highlighting her nimble fighting style and resourceful wit. Mina is as loyal as they come and her lifelong friendship with the King is something we definitely wanted to translate in her design’s latest rendition.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/353cb659e196e31ffaf26894d12437a05050e1e8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9bdd61262b6f79d10a6faf1b44d78db92e585a03.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/1fe4f92fa087a27a1027eb950179d21fb9f0fe75.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Feature Spotlight - Trinkets
notes.content:
In the Realms, conflict and war are as familiar as the dawn. His Majesty the King has faced them throughout his life, savoring the fleeting moments of peace that grace his lands. Until now, swords, axes, and bows, wielded by brave men and women, were sufficient to safeguard the Kingdom.

But that was before.

Now, a shadow looms—a threat unlike any they have faced. This is no time to linger on past grievances, for the very fabric of the Kingdom and all sovereigns across the planet hangs in the balance.
It is time... to rally! Assemble the mightiest Warriors from every Realm! Legends and heroes alike, united and ready to reclaim our peace! But raw strength alone will not suffice. A new power awaits: the Trinkets! Discover now how these ancient artifacts will elevate your might and dramatically enhance your chances of triumph over your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/ac3ad342fb4633ae34a75b06bfadf94ed4eb1a75.png[/img]

In [b]Royal Revolt Warriors[/b], Trinkets are magical gizmos that hold incredible potency. Each carrying its own unique power, your Warriors can use them to buff just about any aspect of their skills: Speed, Damage, Range, anything that can help you to become the ultimate Warriors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5091a3a2bf5d16a5a8fe1360ffc2213eb5d4d90e.png[/img]

In combination with all the different Weapon types, they don’t just amplify combat efficiency, they open up sheer endless possibilities when it comes to designing your personal success formula. Your gameplay, your way: create the perfect combination, wait until you get your favorite Trinket available, and unleash your power, to become the danger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/929dbd59b277c71058c0c2b06ed678b83d14a5da.png[/img]

Trinkets can either amplify a Warrior's strengths or compensate for their weaknesses. Understanding which trinket complements each hero is crucial for success. 

For example, Sam's [b]Gaia Harp[/b] summons leaves that circle around him, covering all blind spots, but once it goes on cooldown, he’s left vulnerable. By equipping [b]Dragon Fangs[/b] (which increase Attack Speed) and the [b]Pocket Watch[/b] (which extends Attack Duration), you effectively eliminate the cooldown. The next attack begins before the previous one ends, briefly doubling his projectile count and keeping him constantly protected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/f026be64d9006e2d7ab262a91ae4f84906e34acb.gif[/img]

[b]Christa[/b], on the other hand, has high health and great damage potential, plus the ability to stun enemies, but her main weakness is her slow speed. While it might seem logical to give her [b]Shadow Boots[/b] to improve mobility, sometimes it's better to play to her strengths. Equipping her with [b]Verdant Blessing[/b] for health regeneration,[b] Nordic Plate[/b] for increased armor, and[b] Royal Amulet[/b] and[b] O.L.U.M.[/b] to boost damage output can make her so powerful that movement becomes unnecessary. She can stand her ground in the thick of enemies without much risk, and no one shall pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/fbdaec40bd32d204aeec014ff022afac39a8b287.gif[/img]

The [b]Occult Rune[/b] is a unique Trinket—it boosts the experience gained from defeating enemies but sacrifices an upgrade in the process. It's an excellent early-game choice when enemies are less threatening, but as the game progresses, it becomes riskier. However, this drawback doesn’t apply when playing as [b]the King[/b]. For him, picking up the Occult Rune is always a good option, as it allows him to enchant his sword into the powerful [b]Spectral Blade[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e2a7350394c8b36d0af4e1b5146396893117cbef.gif[/img]

Additionally, there are Trinkets that are universally good on any hero. [b]O.L.U.M[/b]. increases the attack area, [b]Royal Amulet[/b] boosts attack damage, and [b]Ahriman Wing[/b] raises the critical hit chance of all weapons, making them reliable choices for any build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/fdf978cc33964ad98f25c319c5b6f4274c3fa255.png[/img]

[list]
[*] You can have a maximum of 6 Trinkets at a time, so plan ahead
[*] Trinkets can be upgraded to a max level of 4 during a game
[*] Not every Trinket is available from the beginning, some take certain conditions to unlock
[*] Check the Quests Menu for unlock conditions
[*] Level 4 Trinkets are needed to unleash any Weapon Enchantment
[*] Rune Trinkets have a powerful effect, but they also come with a downside
[*] Try compensating these side effects with other Trinkets
[/list]

You can still enjoy the demo while it lasts, and get to know your favorite combo in depths!
Happy gaming,
Kane, Community Manager

tags.feature: Now, a shadow looms—a threat unlike any they have faced. This is no time to linger on past grievances, for the very fabric of the Kingdom and all sovereigns across the planet hangs in the balance. It is time... to rally! Assemble the mightiest Warriors from every Realm! Legends and heroes alike, united and ready to reclaim our peace! But raw strength alone will not suffice. A new power awaits: the Trinkets! Discover now how these ancient artifacts will elevate your might and dramatically enhance your chances of triumph over your foes!

In Royal Revolt Warriors, Trinkets are magical gizmos that hold incredible potency. Each carrying its own unique power, your Warriors can use them to buff just about any aspect of their skills: Speed, Damage, Range, anything that can help you to become the ultimate Warriors.

In combination with all the different Weapon types, they don’t just amplify combat efficiency, they open up sheer endless possibilities when it comes to designing your personal success formula. Your gameplay, your way: create the perfect combination, wait until you get your favorite Trinket available, and unleash your power, to become the danger.
Trinkets can either amplify a Warrior's strengths or compensate for their weaknesses. Understanding which trinket complements each hero is crucial for success.

For example, Sam's Gaia Harp summons leaves that circle around him, covering all blind spots, but once it goes on cooldown, he’s left vulnerable. By equipping Dragon Fangs (which increase Attack Speed) and the Pocket Watch (which extends Attack Duration), you effectively eliminate the cooldown. The next attack begins before the previous one ends, briefly doubling his projectile count and keeping him constantly protected.

Christa, on the other hand, has high health and great damage potential, plus the ability to stun enemies, but her main weakness is her slow speed. While it might seem logical to give her Shadow Boots to improve mobility, sometimes it's better to play to her strengths. Equipping her with Verdant Blessing for health regeneration, Nordic Plate for increased armor, and Royal Amulet and O.L.U.M. to boost damage output can make her so powerful that movement becomes unnecessary. She can stand her ground in the thick of enemies without much risk, and no one shall pass.

The Occult Rune is a unique Trinket—it boosts the experience gained from defeating enemies but sacrifices an upgrade in the process. It's an excellent early-game choice when enemies are less threatening, but as the game progresses, it becomes riskier. However, this drawback doesn’t apply when playing as the King. For him, picking up the Occult Rune is always a good option, as it allows him to enchant his sword into the powerful Spectral Blade.

Additionally, there are Trinkets that are universally good on any hero. O.L.U.M. increases the attack area, Royal Amulet boosts attack damage, and Ahriman Wing raises the critical hit chance of all weapons, making them reliable choices for any build.
You can have a maximum of 6 Trinkets at a time, so plan ahead
Trinkets can be upgraded to a max level of 4 during a game
Not every Trinket is available from the beginning, some take certain conditions to unlock
Check the Quests Menu for unlock conditions
Level 4 Trinkets are needed to unleash any Weapon Enchantment
Rune Trinkets have a powerful effect, but they also come with a downside
Try compensating these side effects with other Trinkets

notes.title: The Second Royal Revolt Warriors Demo is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors!

The wait is over! Our second major demo for [b]Royal Revolt Warriors[/b] has just been released, and it’s packed with fresh content and new challenges. 

Here’s a sneak peek at the latest additions to the game that we’d love for you to explore:
[list]
[*] [b]New Warrior Abilities[/b]: Some characters now come with unique abilities, such as Dashing and special attacks.
[*] [b]Two New Maps[/b]: Discover brand new battlegrounds, with challenging end bosses.
[*] [b]Weapon Enchantments[/b]: Combine Weapons and Trinkets to create powerful Enchantments.
[*] [b]New Warriors[/b]: [b]The Cultist[/b] and [b]Umberto[/b] now join the roster, fighting alongside our other Warriors.
[*] [b]New Trinkets[/b]: Powerful Runes that offer both advantages and disadvantages.
[*] [b]Hard Mode[/b]: By popular demand, we’ve added a hard mode for those seeking a tougher challenge.
[*] [b]More language support[/b] for: Italian, French and Spanish
[*] [b]Improved gameplay[/b]: Improved balancing to make the game play even more fun.
[*] [b]Improved UI/UX[/b]: Few changes on the UI and UX based on the user feedback.
[/list]
We can’t wait to hear what you think! Your feedback has been incredible so far, and it's shaping the future of [b]Royal Revolt Warriors[/b]. Jump into the new demo, and let us know what you love (or what you want more of)!

Let the battle continue! 💥

notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Warriors![/h2]

We’re excited to welcome you to an exclusive preview of [b]Royal Revolt Warriors![/b] The first demo is now live, and we can't wait for you to dive into the action-packed world we've crafted for you. 

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136050/Royal_Revolt_Warriors_Demo/]Download the demo[/url][/h3]

[h3]Here's a taste of what you can experience:[/h3]

[i][h3]Command Unique Warriors[/h3][/i]
Unlock and lead [b]5 unique Warriors[/b], each bringing their own strengths and stories to the battlefield. 
[i]
[h3]Battle Through the Royal Forest[/h3][/i]
Step into the [b]Royal Forest[/b], a once peaceful place now twisted by dark forces. As you journey through this ominous environment, you’ll uncover secrets that may reveal the origins of this creeping evil.

[i][h3]Wield a Variety of Weapons[/h3][/i]
With [b]9 distinct weapons[/b] at your disposal, you can customize your combat style to suit your strategy. From swift sword strikes to powerful magical attacks, there’s a weapon for every type of Warrior. Adapt your arsenal to face the varied challenges that lie ahead.

[i][h3]Team Up in Couch Co-Op[/h3][/i]
Share the adventure with a friend in [b]two-player couch co-op[/b] mode. Coordinating with a partner makes for even more exciting and dynamic gameplay as you tackle enemies and overcome obstacles together.
[i]
[h3]Level Up with Meta-Upgrades[/h3][/i]
Boost your Warriors' abilities with [b]meta-upgrades[/b], giving you the edge in battle. As the challenges intensify, your strategic choices will be key to turning the tide in your favor.

[i][h3]Your Feedback Matters[/h3][/i]
We're eager to hear what you think of the [b]Royal Revolt Warriors[/b] demo! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine the game. Help us make this the best experience it can be.
